faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services

items.question: What industries do you work with?
items.answer: We work with businesses across various industries including finance, healthcare, retail, logistics, and the public sector. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific regulatory and operational needs of each sector.

items.question: How does a typical engagement begin?
items.answer: We start with a free consultation to understand your business goals and current IT landscape. From there, we propose a tailored plan with clear milestones, timelines, and deliverables.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support after a project is delivered?
items.answer: Yes. We offer managed services and IT support packages to ensure your systems remain secure, up to date, and running smoothly long after the initial project is complete.

items.question: Can you work with our existing IT team?
items.answer: Absolutely. We frequently collaborate with in-house IT teams, providing specialised expertise to complement their existing capabilities without disrupting workflows.

items.question: Are your services available outside of Belgium?
items.answer: Yes. While we are based in Brussels, we serve clients across the European Union and can work remotely or on-site depending on your needs.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Founded in Brussels, Shady AS SRL was born from a passion for helping businesses navigate the complex world of information technology. We believe that every organisation, regardless of size, deserves access to expert IT guidance.
story.p2: Over the years, we've grown from a small consultancy into a full-service IT partner, serving clients across Belgium and beyond. Our deep understanding of the Belgian and European business landscape sets us apart.
story.p3: Today, we continue to innovate and adapt, ensuring our clients stay ahead in an ever-changing digital world.
